notes.title: Release Game and DLC + Unique Release Day Item + Limited Time Item Shop
notes.notes:
[h3]Release[/h3]
We are finally releasing our game, as well as DLC with rare drop and first day unique item!

[h3]DLC[/h3]
We are happy to announce that we have released our DLC with unique Rare Drop!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3081350/Hamster_Combat__Road_to_Whale/
By buying DLC you will instantly get:
[list]
[*] 3 keys for locked chests, each of them cost 0.25$ if you buy them separately
[*] 1 DLC chest
[*] Access to DLC chest drop for playtime, every 3 hours you will get 1 DLC chest with low chance to get Locked Chest Key
[/list]
[h3]DLC Discount[/h3]
For [b]2 weeks[/b] you will be able to buy [b]DLC[/b] with [b]40% discount[/b], so do not miss your chance to increase your loot, unlock new great items and increase your collection!

[h3] Release Day Unique Drop[/h3]
We start dropping time limited unique item for release day! [b]For 1 days only you will be able to get special Scientist Hamster[/b] just for opening game!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/99fd3d3c70497510753e1ae17e520b4a63f99937.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/ac4011e81a01f5af7322879f3f442fb57b504113.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New shop items available only for week[/h3]
In addition, we start selling time-limited unique poops in our item store, first two of them:
[list]
[*] Samurai Hamster
[*] Girl Hamster
[/list][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/20cd527a5d51393adbd18d372360398d99d24a0c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/e25da910b870d18f97c95cf206c336aafe772347.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/5c6164bd07c9bb8f0b5ddfaa16c26097dcf38266.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/78c1b4a6c77e2f466939fc34ffdb0bee075b171b.png[/img][/url]
They will be available for buying for [b]week only[/b]!

[h3]Unique Item for Beta Testers[/h3]
We are [b]turning off unique drop for beta testers[/b], now this is only possible to obtain from other players on community market, we are [b]appreciating all beta testers[/b] for their feedback and participation! For duration of beta test, we granted 64 beta keys, so [b]only 64 Dull Hamsters exist[/b]!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/657ffc95f9f1791f9abd8dbf413e6b3b3ae981de.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/e1ed1afbd5e69ae794fe9be179dd095312074b93.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Don`t forget to join our discord:[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/7srK8wsT][img]https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png[/img][/url]
[h3]And join you developer group:[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Yq8hYprj/b25b6c2bd0578570818bb76830d701e4228ed5f6-full.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Uncomming release + Invite to beta test with unique item!
notes.notes:
[h3]Release:[/h3]
We are releasing our game at [b]11 Jule 2024 8:00 PM GTM+3[/b]. On release we will be giving everyone [b]unique item[/b] for just logging in a game, this offer will be available for [b]only 1 day after release[/b]!

[h3]Drops:[/h3]
We also want to let you know that our game will contain [b]common drop for every 3 hours[/b], and [b]rare drop for every 18 hours[/b], this can be collected without any action and also do not require you to spend that much time in the game.

[h3]Beta Access with unique drop:[/h3]
From this moment we [b]starting to take requests for beta access[/b] to our game, with [b]special item[/b] for our beta testers.
If you want to take a part you should [b]join our developer group[/b]:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Yq8hYprj/b25b6c2bd0578570818bb76830d701e4228ed5f6-full.jpg[/img][/url]
And [b]message me[/b] on steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/id/IWannaSeeYourCry/

Or in our[b] discord channel[/b] in special text channel called "[b]beta-requests[/b]":
[url=https://discord.gg/7srK8wsT][img]https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png[/img][/url]
If you message me on discord please include your steam profile link.

[h3]Item for beta testers:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075272/657ffc95f9f1791f9abd8dbf413e6b3b3ae981de.png[/img]

[b]Special item drop for beta testers will be available only before release.[/b]
